name: Erich Schermerhorn

nadir.desc: The property consists of a primary residence and multiple outbuildings nestled among dense mature evergreen trees|Open grassy clearings are present between clusters of trees|A driveway flanks the wooded lot to the left of the residence|The majority of the property is covered by heavy tree coverage, with structures only partially visible from above|The site has a rural forested character.

alpha.desc: The front approach to the property shows dense mature evergreen trees lining the access route|Portions of the main residence and outbuildings are visible through the tree cover|Open grassy areas appear between the structures and tree clusters|The driveway provides access through the wooded setting.

bravo.desc: The left side of the property shows dense evergreen tree coverage with the main residence and outbuildings partially visible among the trees|Open clearings and grassy areas are interspersed with the heavy vegetation|The wooded character dominates this side of the lot.

charlie.desc: The rear of the property is heavily wooded with dense mature evergreen trees|Limited openings in the coverage reveal portions of structures and open grassy areas|Tree coverage is continuous across much of the rear portion of the lot, with the property extending into a forested setting.

delta.desc: The right side of the property shows dense evergreen trees surrounding the main residence and outbuildings|Open grassy clearings are visible between tree clusters|The structures are set within a heavily wooded environment, with limited clear views of the full building elevations.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a driveway that flanks the lot along the left side to the cluster of buildings. Mature evergreen trees surround the structures and significantly limit visibility and sightlines from most approaches. Open grassy clearings near the buildings provide some space for staging. The property is located in a rural forested area with heavy tree cover that may impact emergency vehicle and personnel movement around the structures. Access from Huckleberry Ln Lane leads into a wooded setting.
